timingBoundary.driverElapsedMs: SDK streaming driver, source and sink callbacks, checksum and output validation; excludes module load and source setup.
timingBoundary.trialWallMs: Wall time around streaming driver and final validation and closure, excluding module load and source setup.
timingBoundary.steady: One Node process and one loaded core per scenario; a new stream and source per sample.
timingBoundary.isolatedColdProcess: One fresh Node process and one trial per scenario for cold load and process peak RSS; OS caches are not cleared.
